generated_by: observed virtme-ng runs on the qualified x86-64 host (recorded by hand)
notes: Both lanes use software emulation (--disable-kvm, TCG). KVM hardware acceleration is not available to unprivileged users on the qualifying host (/dev/kvm is root:kvm without a caller grant), so TCG is the pinned default for every lane.
The runner binary is resolved via PATH at run time; its version and SHA-256 must match this lock. Absolute install paths are intentionally not pinned.

Kernel images are the Ubuntu mainline builds cached by virtme-ng under ~/.cache/virtme-ng/<release>/; the .deb file names and hashes below identify the exact artifacts. A lane whose cache is absent fails the matrix; lanes are never silently skipped.

execution-contract-v1: the runner entry is a console-script stub, so the lock also pins its exec chain (null here: the entry runs directly), the shebang interpreter hash, the first-party package modules, and the emulator image hash. Admission resolves each once and probes versions only after every static check passes.

The vng console script invokes the bare name 'virtme-run' through a shell, so the lock pins that launcher too (entry, exec chain, shared interpreter, virtme.* implementation modules). Suites run with a farm-first PATH, so the shell's PATH selection resolves to the admitted virtme-run, never an ambient shadow. virtme-run has no --version probe; its --help probe is record-only and identity rests on the hashes.

distribution bindings are enforced, never descriptive: each third-party runner dependency must resolve to a same-version .dist-info whose METADATA bytes match metadata_sha256 and whose RECORD bytes match record_sha256, and every file the pinned RECORD lists inside the distribution root is re-hashed, so substituted dependency content is refused even when METADATA is untouched. The emulator qemu_version claim must equal the admitted emulator version. An all-zero placeholder digest never admits. Guest-side payloads staged into the initramfs (virtme/guest scripts) and PATH-resolved distribution auxiliaries (socat/ssh/virtiofsd) stay outside the host admission chain.
_virtualenv is the environment shim executed via _virtualenv.pth at every interpreter startup; its bytes are pinned with the first-party modules.

interpreter.description: console-script interpreter of the uv tool install, resolved via the entry shebang and hash-pinned (install paths are not pinned)

distribution.note: First-party runner modules are hashed per-file above; third-party dependencies are bound to their installed METADATA bytes plus the RECORD manifest below (the manifest re-binds every installed file), and the emulator claim must equal the admitted emulator version. All bindings are enforced at admission, before any probe.
